description: Structured skill definition for llama.cpp-based model execution. This is the source of truth — the prose reference (skills/llama_cpp.md) supplements this but is not authoritative.

--ctx-size.description: Context window length (tokens). Set based on task complexity and available memory.

--mmap.description: Memory-map the model file (recommended for M-series chips — enables instant mapping and faster loading).

--n-gpu-layers.description: Number of layers to offload to Metal on Apple Silicon. Set to 0 to force CPU-only execution.

--temp.description: Sampling temperature. Lower = more deterministic, higher = more creative.

--top-p.description: Nucleus sampling top-p threshold. Controls diversity vs. coherence of output.
